descriptions.w3d_release_slot_node_80173504: Releases one slot node and returns the status of the admitted base node reset 0x801859f8. Reaches the slot group through the held handle (+128, group at +48), opens the group's copy-on-write byte array at +96 for writing (unshared store locked in place with its +28 count incremented, otherwise reserved through 0x801ef048 with element size 1 and append flag 2) and clears the byte at the node's index (+124). Releases the held handle through its table slot 4 and clears it, fetches the group bitset 0x801720c0 for the resource at +116 (via the identity accessor 0x80343808) and the node's group byte at +4, clears the index bit, unregisters the node through the resource's table slot 15, and sets bit 2 of the group's flag byte at +11 when the bitset has no set bit below its bit count. Names inferred; offsets observed; no owned data. Uses an unsigned mask for all32bit positions.
